name: AlgoVoi JCS Conformance Vectors
hash_note: Per-file sha256 is computed over LF-normalised bytes; .gitattributes pins eol=lf so `sha256sum <file>` on a fresh checkout reproduces these values. The authoritative conformance signal is the per-vector canonical-bytes recompute carried inside each vector file (line-ending independent); the file hash is a convenience integrity check.

anchor_sets.anchors_to: Agent identity reference; passport_ref is the agent_ref consumed by spend_guardrail_lite_v1. Instance of the binding framework (no new IETF section).

total_vectors_note: 31 sets / 256 entries (incl. agent_passport_lite_v1) (incl. policy_binding_v1 + compliance_gate_lite_v1 + spend_guardrail_lite_v1 + spend_decision_v1 + substrate_guard_v1, Python+TS byte-for-byte) = JCS canonicalisation vectors across the receipt lifecycle, lifecycle/binding, .epi interop+PQC, RFC 9421 receipt evidence, and adversarial fixtures. spend_decision_v1 anchors the decision_ref construction (ALLOW/DENY/REFER) and the spend_decision chain prev_entry_hash linkage; its ALLOW/DENY refs are byte-identical to spend_guardrail_lite_v1. substrate_guard_v1 is the resource-bounds edition of input validation: profile_ref content-addresses the limits in force, and guard(value, profile) rejects a well-formed but resource-hostile payload (size/depth/keys/array/string/nodes/unsafe-number) with a named code BEFORE canonicalization; every bound is a pure structural property so it is identical across implementations. settlement_action_binding_v1 cross-validated 8-impl (48/48, 2026-06-18); epi sets Python+Rust direct; see _attestations for the per-set runner matrix.

cross_validation.languages_note: Eight independent, non-overlapping JCS RFC 8785 implementations, including the RFC 8785 author's own Java implementation (Anders Rundgren).
cross_validation.method_note: Agreements are reported per dated attestation run. The cumulative directly-executed JCS total is 880/880 as of 2026-06-18 (192+320+64+48+24+40+32+112+48), the final +48 being settlement_action_binding_v1 (8-impl, 2026-06-18). policy_binding_v1 and compliance_gate_lite_v1 are Python+TypeScript byte-for-byte and are NOT folded into the 8-impl directly-executed cumulative. zkp_receipt_v1 (2026-06-04) was directly executed across 5 implementations (40/40); the remaining 3 are asserted by transitivity and are deliberately NOT added to the directly-executed cumulative. adversarial_isolation_v1 Claim 1 (96/96 input bytes) is counted separately and NOT folded into the positive-vector cumulative. epi_interop_v0 and epi_pqc_v0 JCS runs (2026-06-16) ARE included: they confirm the same RFC 8785 canonicalisation discipline holds over external EPI-format payloads.

runs.agreements: Claim 1 (input bytes) 96/96 direct; Claim 2 (rejection) 12/12 reference-impl PoR (not an 8-lang byte claim)

cross_validation.cumulative_direct_jcs: 832/832 byte-for-byte positive-vector agreements (as of 2026-06-17: 192+320+64+48+24+40+32+112). Separately, adversarial_isolation_v1 adds 96/96 byte-for-byte agreements on adversarial INPUTS (Claim 1); its rejection proof (Claim 2, 12/12) is reference-impl behaviour and is NOT folded into the positive-vector cumulative.

signature_survival.note: 8 implementations x 3 checks (signing-base + content-digest + Ed25519 verify) through a 3-hop TLS-re-terminating proxy chain, over the legacy algovoi-v0 signing base (lowercased @method, no @signature-params line). The RFC 9421 Â§2.5-conformant companion is signature_survival_rfc9421 below.

signature_survival_rfc9421.note: RFC 9421 Â§2.5-conformant signing base (@method case-preserved, created as a parameter, trailing @signature-params line). All 8 independent implementations verify the full chain (signing-base reconstruction + RFC 9530 content-digest + Ed25519): Python (algovoi-rfc9421-verifier mode=rfc9421), Node, Go, Rust (ed25519-dalek), Java (JDK 17 stdlib), PHP (libsodium), .NET (NSec.Cryptography), Ruby. Verified 2026-06-13, matching the v0 set's 8/8 on the same host.

interop_sets.name: epi_interop_v0

interop_note: Interop sets cross-validate the JCS canonicalisation method against an external implementation. epi_interop_v0 was originally 2-impl (AlgoVoi + EPI Recorder, 2026-06-11) and upgraded to 8-impl direct JCS (2026-06-16). The 8-impl JCS run IS included in cumulative_direct_jcs. Interop sets are NOT counted in total_anchor_sets / total_vectors.

proposal_sets.name: epi_pqc_v0

proposal_note: Proposal sets are single-implementation AlgoVoi fixtures published for standards discussion (here: the .epi PQC profile, microsoft/agent-governance-toolkit Discussion #806). They are NOT cross-validated and NOT folded into the conformance or interop totals.
